assessment.whatWouldChangeThis: The outcome would drop if the evidence behind it is revoked, expires, or turns out to be correlated. Revoking one of the independent sources, or disproving one signal type, leaves at most 3 independent indicator(s), which can only reach caution. A single source or a single signal type can never flag a contributor.

whyAiTextDetectionFails: Text-origin detectors produce false positives, including on non-native English writers with unusual phrasing.
AI-assisted work can be correct and valuable; how a patch was drafted is not evidence about whether it is good.
Spam is a behavior pattern: volume, timing, cross-project similarity, account age, network structure and maintainer outcomes.
TrustWeave never inspects text origin. The same behavioral rules run on both examples, and the outcomes and reasons are shown side by side.
explainer.caveat: The human-written label comes from simulator ground truth. The system itself only sees PR behavior, signed records and network signals.
